brief.zh: 下游需要可安全重跑的每日数据分区。处理同批重复、重放和错误分区；发现不合法批次时保留上一份可用分区，并给出隔离记录。
brief.en: A data consumer needs a safe daily partition replacement. Deduplicate replayed rows, quarantine wrong-partition input and retain the last good partition on failure.

zh: 内容对照、质量阻断与恢复记录
同输入重跑字段内容与摘要一致
异常批次不替换最后可用结果
en: Reconcile the complete result with the supplied input IDs and values.
Appending a replay duplicates a record instead of replacing the partition. This is a blocking regression.

failure.zh: 行数相同但关键字段变化必须失败
failure.en: Appending a replay duplicates a record instead of replacing the partition.

zh: 隔离、补数与下游可见性
en: Locate the decision and supporting input/result in your deliverables.
Explain remaining uncertainty, your contribution and what the receiving role must verify.

environment.scope: Original small deterministic teaching application; no real enterprise traffic or model inference

zh: 下游需要可安全重跑的每日数据分区。处理同批重复、重放和错误分区；发现不合法批次时保留上一份可用分区，并给出隔离记录。
行数相同但关键字段变化必须失败；先制作能暴露这项错误的最小检查。
逐个核对输入和产物位置，保留修订前后、本人贡献与尚未验证范围。
en: A data consumer needs a safe daily partition replacement.
Reproduce this failure first: Appending a replay duplicates a record instead of replacing the partition.
Check every result ID and preserve a before/after record; explain what this fixture cannot establish.
